body: Gabriel Bruno (CFO) on 2025-10-30 (Q3-2025 earnings call transcript (Motley Fool)): "we are increasing our cash conversion range to above 100% to better align with performance." Metric: cash conversion FY2025 (FCF / adjusted net income, company). Target: >100%. Deadline: 2025-12-31. Specificity: precise; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: partly. Evidence: Q4-2025 press release table: FY2025 cash conversion 97% (FCF $534.2 mn / adjusted net income $551.3 mn); Q4 alone 35%. A floor raised one quarter before the deadline and then missed by 3 pts; not mentioned on the Q4 call.
